mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -1% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising, and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 10% and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals robust economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM > 1% & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.
